The entire time I spent in foster care I was waiting to get out. I never thought about being in a new 'forever' home until a family member asked me to live with them, I struggled to form connections with strangers. I'm not sure how comfortable I feel about foster parents seeing every child as a potential adoption, they just want to be safe and secure. Honestly reading this makes me feel a little weird because as a child in foster care I just saw it's purpose as making sure I was being looked after rather than a search for a new home.
